sp_murakumo.name: Ame no Murakumo
notes: LP (0x30) and HP (0x32) share the same animation states (21:00 start-up, 21:01 dash/slash).
Code timer0 (s_pl05.c:1537) sets dash delay: 1F for LP, 12F for HP.

sp_warp.name: Warp (Teleport)
notes: Warp has NO attack hitbox — Move Hit Data is intentionally N/A.
Button selects destination: LP = behind near, HP = behind far, LK = above near, HK = above far.
Startup wait uses timer0 = 20F in s_pl05.c:1601; vanish/reappear/land use animation frame durations.

sp_vajra.name: Vajra
notes: LK vs HK only changes horizontal reappear distance in code (s_pl05.c:3201); both share Hit Data 0x4b and all animation states.
States 21:29, 30, 32, 33, 34, 36, 41, 42, 44, 45, 46, 48 are Strider's 3 shadow clones (visual only, no hitbox/hurtbox).

sp_formation_a.name: Formation A (Animal / Robot)
notes: 21:17 is Strider's summon animation. LK spawns the running tiger (23:16..23:21, Hit 0x44); HK spawns the flying robot (23:35, Hit 0x5d).
